tldr: A bounded causal cosine contrast requires a quadratic inverse at a triangular-noise zero. The maximal affine-periodic nullspace yields an explicit observed-density minimum-variance score and the exact regularity boundary \(q>5\) at positive comparable-tail laws. At strict-slack laws this is also the unrestricted ambient-model bound, attained by a data-only original-record estimator locally regular along every dominated ambient quadratic-mean path. Uniform expansion, studentization, mean-square efficiency, and Wald coverage hold on the outer benchmark with \(q\in[5+\eta,8]\), for fixed \(\eta>0\). Trabs' published model is larger, and Goldenshluger--Kim's upper-tail class has no lower envelope; no universal frontier for that class is claimed. Derivative recovery, generic efficiency, and lattice regression are inherited.
gap: The closest published ingredients do not supply the full-support multiplicity-two weighted quotient together with its primitive regularity boundary and original-record studentized attainment.
